recipes.title: Creamy Tuscan Chicken Pasta
recipes.description: Tender chicken in a silky sun-dried tomato and cream sauce over pappardelle.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil over high heat for the pasta.
Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and season 300g chicken breast with salt and pepper.
Sear the chicken over medium-high heat for 6–7 minutes per side until golden and cooked through.
Transfer the cooked chicken to a plate and let rest for 2 minutes, then slice into strips.
In the same skillet, sauté 3 minced garlic cloves over medium heat for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add 80g sun-dried tomatoes and stir over medium heat for 1 minute to release flavors.
Pour in 120ml chicken stock and 200ml heavy cream, stirring constantly over medium heat for 3 minutes until thickened.
Return the sliced chicken to the skillet, season with salt and black pepper, and simmer over low heat for 2 minutes.
Cook the 250g pappardelle in the boiling salted water according to package directions until al dente.
Drain the pasta and divide between two bowls, then top with the creamy chicken sauce.
Garnish each bowl with 30g grated parmesan and 5 fresh basil leaves.

recipes.title: Vietnamese Banh Mi Sandwich
recipes.description: Crispy baguette filled with pâté, cold cuts, pickled vegetables, and cilantro.
instructions: Combine 3 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tbsp sugar, and 1/2 tsp salt in a bowl and whisk until sugar dissolves.
Add the julienned carrot and daikon radish to the vinegar mixture and let pickle for 5 minutes.
Split the baguette lengthwise and lightly toast it in a toaster or under the broiler.
Spread 2 tbsp mayonnaise on the bottom half and 60g pâté on the top half of the baguette.
Layer 60g deli ham and 60g deli pork slices onto the bottom half of the baguette.
Drain the pickled vegetables and arrange them on top of the meat along with 1 sliced jalapeño.
Sprinkle 15g fresh cilantro and 1/2 tsp maggi seasoning over the vegetables.
Close the sandwich by placing the top half over the filling and cut diagonally if desired before serving.

recipes.title: Spanish Chorizo & Chickpea Stew
recipes.description: Hearty one-pot stew with chorizo, chickpeas, peppers, and tomatoes in fragrant spiced broth.
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and add 200g sliced chorizo.
Cook the chorizo over medium-high heat for 4 minutes until it releases oils and edges begin to brown.
Remove the chorizo with a slotted spoon and set aside, leaving the oil in the pot.
Add 1 medium diced onion and 1 large diced red bell pepper to the pot over medium heat and sauté for 5 minutes.
Stir in 4 minced garlic cloves, 1 tsp smoked paprika, and 1/2 tsp cumin over medium heat for 1 minute.
Pour in 400g canned tomatoes and 300ml vegetable stock, then add 1 bay leaf and stir well.
Return the cooked chorizo to the pot and add 240g drained chickpeas, then bring to a simmer over medium heat.
Simmer the stew over low heat for 10 minutes until flavors meld and liquid reduces slightly.
Taste and season with salt and black pepper as needed, then remove the bay leaf.
Divide the stew between two bowls and garnish with 10g fresh chopped parsley.

recipes.title: Crispy Tofu & Rainbow Vegetable Stir-Fry
recipes.description: Golden tofu with vibrant stir-fried vegetables in a light ginger-soy glaze.
instructions: Press 280g extra-firm tofu between paper towels under a weight for 10 minutes to remove excess moisture.
Cut pressed tofu into 2cm cubes and toss with 1 tsp cornstarch until evenly coated.
Heat 2 tbsp vegetable oil in a large wok or skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering.
Add tofu cubes and sear over medium-high heat for 6–7 minutes, turning occasionally, until golden on all sides.
Transfer tofu to a plate and add broccoli and carrot to the pan over medium-high heat for 3 minutes.
Add red bell pepper, snap peas, minced ginger, and garlic; stir-fry over medium-high heat for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Whisk together 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, and 1 tsp sesame oil in a small bowl.
Return tofu to the pan and pour the sauce over all vegetables; toss over medium-high heat for 1–2 minutes until glazed.
Plate the stir-fry and garnish with 1 tsp sesame seeds and chopped green onions.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Chickpea & Herb Salad Wrap
recipes.description: Lemony chickpeas with fresh herbs, cucumber, and feta in a whole-wheat tortilla.
instructions: Rinse 400g canned chickpeas under cold water and drain thoroughly.
In a bowl, combine drained chickpeas with 2 tbsp lemon juice, 2 tbsp olive oil, 1/2 tsp cumin, 1/4 tsp sea salt, and 1/8 tsp black pepper.
Add 200g diced cucumber, 150g halved cherry tomatoes, 30g diced red onion, 60g crumbled feta, 10g parsley, and 5g mint; toss gently.
Warm 2 large whole wheat tortillas in a dry skillet over medium heat for 30 seconds per side until pliable.
Divide 50g fresh spinach between the two tortillas, then top each with half the chickpea mixture and roll tightly.
Serve wraps immediately, halved if desired.

recipes.title: Vietnamese Pho-Inspired Noodle Soup
recipes.description: Aromatic broth with rice noodles, mushrooms, bok choy, and fresh herb garnish.
instructions: Heat 1 liter vegetable broth in a large pot over medium-high heat until simmering.
Add 3 star anise pods, 1 cinnamon stick, 20g ginger slices, 1/2 onion, and 3 crushed garlic cloves; simmer over medium heat for 8 minutes.
Strain the broth through a fine-mesh sieve, discarding solids, and return to pot over medium heat.
Add 1 tbsp soy sauce and 1 tsp fish sauce to the strained broth; taste and adjust seasoning if needed.
Bring a separate pot of water to a boil and cook 120g dried rice noodles according to package directions until tender; drain and divide between serving bowls.
Return broth to a simmer over medium-high heat and add 150g sliced mushrooms and 200g bok choy; simmer for 3–4 minutes until vegetables are tender.
Ladle the hot broth with mushrooms and bok choy over the cooked noodles in each bowl.
Top each bowl with 40g julienned carrot, Thai basil leaves, cilantro leaves, and sliced fresh chili.
Serve immediately with lime wedges for squeezing over the soup.

recipes.title: Thai Green Curry with Jasmine Rice
recipes.description: Fragrant coconut curry with tender chicken, bamboo shoots, and Thai basil.
instructions: Rinse jasmine rice under cold water, then combine with 1.5 cups water in a pot.
Cover and reduce heat to low, simmer for 15 minutes until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed.
Cut 400g chicken breast into 2cm cubes for even cooking.
Heat 1 tbsp vegetable oil over medium-high heat in a large pan or wok.
Add 2 minced garlic cloves and 1 small sliced onion, stir-fry over medium-high heat for 2 minutes.
Stir in 3 tbsp Thai green curry paste and cook over medium-high heat for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add chicken cubes and stir-fry over medium-high heat for 4 minutes until sealed on edges.
Pour in 400ml coconut milk, add 1 cup drained bamboo shoots, and bring to simmer over medium heat.
Reduce to medium-low heat and simmer for 8 minutes until chicken is cooked through.
Stir in 1 tbsp fish sauce and juice of 1 lime, then season to taste.
Remove from heat and tear in 1/4 cup fresh Thai basil just before serving.
Serve curry over jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Japanese Teriyaki Salmon with Sesame Noodles
recipes.description: Glazed salmon fillet paired with chilled sesame noodles and crisp vegetables.
instructions: Combine 3 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp mirin, 1 tbsp sake, 1 tbsp minced ginger, and 1 minced garlic clove in a small bowl.
Bring a large pot of salted water to boil over high heat, then add 200g egg noodles.
Cook noodles over high heat for 7 minutes until tender, then drain and rinse under cold water.
Toss cooled noodles with 2 tbsp sesame oil and 2 tbsp rice vinegar in a bowl, then set aside.
Heat 1 tbsp vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat for 1 minute.
Place 2 salmon fillets skin-side up in the skillet and sear over medium-high heat for 4 minutes until golden.
Flip salmon, reduce heat to medium, pour teriyaki glaze over fillets, and cook for 3 minutes.
Cook salmon over medium heat for 2 more minutes until cooked through (internal temp 63°C).
Divide sesame noodles between two plates, top each with one salmon fillet.
Top noodles with 1 medium julienned carrot, 1/2 medium julienned cucumber, and 2 sliced green onion stalks.
Sprinkle 2 tbsp sesame seeds over the entire dish and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Creamy Tomato Pasta with Crispy Bacon
recipes.description: Silky tomato cream sauce with crispy bacon and fresh basil over tender pasta.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil over high heat for pasta.

Cook 250g pasta in boiling water until al dente, then drain well.
Toss hot pasta with the tomato cream sauce and top with 50g grated parmesan and fresh basil.

recipes.title: Vietnamese Banh Mi-Style Chicken Sandwich
recipes.description: Crispy bread with glazed chicken, pickled vegetables, cilantro, and mayo.
instructions: Combine 3 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp honey, 2 cloves minced garlic, and 1 tbsp lime juice in a bowl.
Marinate 2 × 150g chicken breasts in the soy-honey mixture for 10 minutes.
Toss julienned carrot and 100g daikon radish with 4 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tbsp sugar, and 1 tsp salt; let sit.
Heat 1 tbsp butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat until foaming.
Sear marinated chicken breasts over medium-high heat for 6 minutes per side until golden and cooked through.
Flip chicken and cook the second side over medium-high heat for 6 minutes until cooked through.
Remove chicken and slice into 1cm strips; set aside.
Split baguette lengthwise and lightly toast cut-side down over medium heat for 2 minutes until crispy.
Spread 3 tbsp mayonnaise on toasted baguette halves.
Layer sliced chicken on each baguette half, then top with pickled vegetables, fresh cilantro, and jalapeño slices.
Press sandwiches together gently and cut diagonally in half; serve immediately.

recipes.title: Spiced Chickpea & Cauliflower Curry with Coconut Milk
recipes.description: Aromatic, creamy curry with roasted cauliflower and tender chickpeas, served over fragrant basmati.
instructions: Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a large heavy-bottomed pot over medium heat.
Add 1 diced medium onion to the pot over medium heat and sauté for 4 minutes until softened.
Stir in 3 minced garlic cloves and 1 tbsp grated ginger over medium heat for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add 1.5 tbsp curry powder, 1 tsp ground cumin, and 1/2 tsp ground turmeric to the pan over medium heat and toast for 1 minute.
Stir in 2 tbsp tomato paste over medium heat and cook for 2 minutes to caramelize slightly.
Add 250g cauliflower florets, 1 can (400g) drained chickpeas, 1 can (400ml) coconut milk, 1 cup vegetable broth, and 1/2 tsp sea salt to the pot.
Bring the curry to a simmer over medium heat, then reduce to medium-low and simmer uncovered for 15 minutes until cauliflower is tender.
Stir in 80g fresh spinach over medium-low heat and simmer for 2 minutes until wilted.
Divide 1.5 cups cooked basmati rice between two serving bowls and ladle curry over rice, garnishing with 2 tbsp fresh cilantro.
